purpose: Controlled ALD-inspired models for staged active-space validation

models.name: surface_hydroxyl_proxy
models.validation_target: CASCI active-space sanity check before bond-stretch scans
models.limitations: Gas-phase water is not a surface cluster; it only tests O-H local chemistry.

models.name: metal_hydride_proxy
models.validation_target: Reduced CASCI benchmark already validated against PySCF CASCI
models.limitations: LiH is a numerically convenient proxy, not an ALD precursor.

models.name: aluminum_hydroxide_proxy
models.role: Minimal Al-O-H fragment for ALD-inspired precursor/surface contact
models.validation_target: HF/CASCI feasibility check followed by active-space refinement
models.limitations: No surface embedding, ligands, transition state or periodic boundary condition.
